### Source Specification (`docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`)
- **Feature artifact path:** `/home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-o-integration-audit-cross-context-events-and-widgets.md`
- **Milestone:** `P2 — MVP / Core Features`
- **Milestone file:** `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`
- **Story:** `P2-O`
- **Surfaces:** `backend`
- **Material:** `no`
- **Dependency:** `P2-I, P2-L, P2-M, P2-N`
- **Milestone Size:** `7` (`AC-1` through `AC-7`)
- **User story (copy verbatim from milestone row):**
  `As a compliance auditor, I want security and domain mutations across iam, configuration, execution, and governance to commit sanitized audit entries and in-app or SMTP notifications via AuditEventPort and NotificationPort, and the dashboard aggregator to query live counts via ExecutionDashboardReadPort and GovernanceDashboardReadPort, so that cross-context auditability and operational alerts are complete.`
- **Cross-context integration coverage (`context-map.md` & `p2-mvp-core-features.md`):**
  - `P2-O`: `audit` <-> `iam`, `execution`, `configuration`, `governance` (`AuditEventPort`, `NotificationPort`, `ExecutionDashboardReadPort`, `GovernanceDashboardReadPort`).
  - Security review triggers (`p2-mvp-core-features.md`): Security audit events (`audit_log_entries` sanitization with `Encode.forJava()`, VAPT F10) and `{id}` notification recipient BOLA checks (VAPT F8), plus `RBAC` and `auth` on `/api/v1/audit-logs`, `/api/v1/notifications/**`, `/api/v1/dashboard/widgets`, and cross-context mutation endpoints.

### Active Lessons (`docs/agents-v0/lessons.md`) whose Scope matches:
- `L-002`: Name PostgreSQL-backed integration tests `*Test.java` unless Maven Failsafe is explicitly wired in `pom.xml`.
- `L-003`: Define dedicated port value types (`AuditEventRecord`, `NotificationCreateCommand` in `com.example.app.audit.port`; `ExecutionDashboardCounts` in `com.example.app.execution.port`; `GovernanceDashboardCounts` in `com.example.app.governance.port`) on cross-context ports rather than returning internal domain entities.
- `L-004` & `L-005`: Annotate refusal-auditing and synchronous-audit-emitting service methods with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` and use 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors.
- `L-007`: When testing asynchronous worker lifecycles (`ReportRunWorkerService`, `AsyncSmtpDispatchWorker`), poll for both the terminal DB status and post-transition worker side effects (audit log row, notification row, and distributed lock release) with bounded retries.
- `L-008`: Expose package-private accessor (`other.jdbcTemplate()`) on `@Repository` classes with copy constructors.
- `L-010` & `L-012`: Normalize or handle optional whitespace around colons (`"key": "value"`) when reading PostgreSQL `JSONB` columns (`audit_log_entries.mutation_payload_json`, `governance_tickets.proposed_payload_json`).
- `L-011`: Call `TransactionAspectSupport.currentTransactionStatus().setRollbackOnly()` when rolling back staged DB writes inside `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)`.
- `L-013`: Truncate test `Instant` timestamps with `.truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.SECONDS)` or `.truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MICROS)` when asserting equality against PostgreSQL `TIMESTAMPTZ`.
- `L-014`: Verify that matched route permissions exist and are active (`is_active = true`, `deleted_at IS NULL`) before applying any self-service or instance-level route shortcut.

### Current Codebase Context (already mapped so no helper brief is needed):
- `com.example.app.audit.port.AuditEventPort` (`AuditEventRecord`) is implemented by `AuditLogService` (`com.example.app.audit.service.AuditLogService`).
- `com.example.app.audit.port.NotificationPort` (`NotificationCreateCommand`) is implemented by `NotificationBellService` (`com.example.app.audit.service.NotificationBellService`), with `AsyncSmtpDispatchWorker` dispatching pending emails via `SmtpMailSenderPort` (`PENDING` -> `SENT` or 5-retry `FAILED_DLQ`).
- `com.example.app.execution.port.ExecutionDashboardReadPort` (`ExecutionDashboardCounts`) is implemented by `ExecutionDashboardReadService`, and `com.example.app.governance.port.GovernanceDashboardReadPort` (`GovernanceDashboardCounts`) is implemented by `GovernanceDashboardReadService`, both queried by `DashboardWidgetAggregator` (`GET /api/v1/dashboard/widgets`).
- In `P2-O`, cross-context domain workflows across `iam` (`OidcAndSessionAuthService`, `RbacManagementService`, `ViewAsOverlayService`, `UserDirectoryAndOnboardingService`), `configuration` (`ReportDefinitionRecipeScheduleService`, `ReferenceLookupTableService`, `ConfigurationGovernanceCutoverAdapter`), `execution` (`ReportRunOrchestratorService`, `ReportRunWorkerService`, `ReportRunArtifactAndEndorsementService`, `ExecutionFreezeAndArchiveAdapter`), and `governance` (`GovernanceTicketWorkflowService`, `GovernanceTicketSubmissionAdapter`, `GovernanceTicketCollaborationService`) must emit sanitized audit log entries (`AuditEventPort.recordEvent`) with expandable `mutation_payload_json` (redacting secret/token/credential keys and sanitizing strings with `Encode.forJava()`) AND emit principal-scoped in-app/SMTP notifications via `NotificationPort.enqueueNotification` on key cross-context operational events (such as governance ticket submission/assignment, ticket endorsement/approval/rejection/cancellation/reassignment/owner-change, role application onboarding submission/decision, report run completion `SUCCESS` or `FAILED` including scheduled runs, and SAP posting approval/archival), while `GET /api/v1/dashboard/widgets` (`DashboardWidgetAggregator`) reflects live cross-context state transitions (`myOpenRuns`, `recentRuns`, `myTodoCount`, `awaitingApproval`, `failedScheduledJobs`) via `ExecutionDashboardReadPort` and `GovernanceDashboardReadPort`.

Write `/home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-o-integration-audit-cross-context-events-and-widgets.md` with `AC-1` through `AC-7` (matching Milestone Size `7`: happy, edge, and negative scenarios covering cross-context `AuditEventPort` consolidation & `GET /api/v1/audit-logs` correlation/filtering, cross-context `NotificationPort` emission across `governance`, `execution`, `configuration`, and `iam` workflows, live `ExecutionDashboardReadPort` & `GovernanceDashboardReadPort` widget transitions on `GET /api/v1/dashboard/widgets`, edge scenario for `Encode.forJava()` sanitization / secret redaction / async SMTP `SENT` & `FAILED_DLQ` resilience / refusal audit persistence on rollback via `noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class`, and negative scenarios for BOLA cross-recipient notification isolation, `View-As` read-only mutation blocking, RBAC/unauthenticated refusals, and `trg_audit_log_entries_immutable` tamper rejection).
3. Include `## Preconditions`, `## Desk check`, `## Out of scope`, `## NFRs`, `## Security-review triggers` (`RBAC`, `auth`, `any {id} path`, and `Sensitive actions`), `## Regulations`, `## Open questions` (`none`), and `## Delivery approvals` (empty table row `| | | | | |`).

### Requirements Summary
- **Milestone / Story**: `P2 — MVP / Core Features` ([p2-mvp-core-features.md](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md)) · `Story: P2-O` · `Surfaces: backend` · `Material: no`
- **User Story**:
  > As a compliance auditor, I want security and domain mutations across iam, configuration, execution, and governance to commit sanitized audit entries and in-app or SMTP notifications via AuditEventPort and NotificationPort, and the dashboard aggregator to query live counts via ExecutionDashboardReadPort and GovernanceDashboardReadPort, so that cross-context auditability and operational alerts are complete.
- **Acceptance Criteria (`AC-1` through `AC-7`)**:
  - **`AC-1` (`happy`)**: Commit sanitized append-only audit entries with expandable JSON mutation payloads across `iam`, `configuration`, `execution`, and `governance` via [`AuditEventPort`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/audit/port/AuditEventPort.java) and correlate/query via `GET /api/v1/audit-logs` with `AUDIT_LOG_SEARCHED` self-auditing.
  - **`AC-2` (`happy`)**: Emit principal-scoped in-app and asynchronous SMTP notifications across `governance`, `configuration`, and `iam` maker-checker workflows (submission, endorsement, approval, rejection, cancellation, reassignment, owner change) via [`NotificationPort`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/audit/port/NotificationPort.java).
  - **`AC-3` (`happy`)**: Emit principal-scoped in-app and asynchronous SMTP notifications on `execution` run completion (`SUCCESS` or `FAILED`, manual or scheduled) and `SAP_REPORT_POSTING` archival via [`NotificationPort`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/audit/port/NotificationPort.java).
  - **`AC-4` (`happy`)**: Reflect live cross-context `execution` and `governance` state transitions (`myOpenRuns`, `recentRuns`, `myTodoCount`, `awaitingApproval`, `failedScheduledJobs`) in `GET /api/v1/dashboard/widgets` via [`ExecutionDashboardReadPort`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/execution/port/ExecutionDashboardReadPort.java) and [`GovernanceDashboardReadPort`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/governance/port/GovernanceDashboardReadPort.java).
  - **`AC-5` (`edge`)**: Sanitize cross-context audit strings with `Encode.forJava()`, redact sensitive keys in `mutation_payload_json`, isolate async SMTP retries (`5` attempts) to `FAILED_DLQ`, and preserve refusal audit entries on domain rollback (`@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)`).
  - **`AC-6` (`negative`)**: Refuse cross-user BOLA access (`HTTP 403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN`) to cross-context notifications and block notification mutations under an active `View-As` overlay (`HTTP 403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`).
  - **`AC-7` (`negative`)**: Refuse unauthenticated (`HTTP 401 AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED`) or unauthorized (`HTTP 403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN`) access to audit, notification, and dashboard APIs and reject any `UPDATE` or `DELETE` tampering on `audit_log_entries` via `trg_audit_log_entries_immutable`.
- **Security Triggers & Regulations**: `RBAC`, `auth`, `any {id} path`, and sensitive actions documented; aligned with BSP Circular 982 / 1019, Philippines Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) & GDPR, and Internal GXI Security Baseline.
- **Open Questions**: `none`.
